units.source_text: 太君闻此消息，大为不满，认为此乃意外之事。

en.t: When the Grand Lady heard this news, she was greatly displeased and considered it an unexpected turn of events.

units.source_text: 这也是难怪她的。

en.t: Nor could she really be blamed for feeling so.

units.source_text: 太君会见源氏时，提及此事。

en.t: When the Grand Lady met Genji, she brought the matter up.

units.source_text: 源氏便向她说明：“启禀太君：此子年事尚幼，本不该为他举行冠礼，教他强装成人。

en.t: Genji then explained to her, “My lady, this boy is still very young, and strictly speaking I should not have held his coming-of-age ceremony and made him put on the appearance of adulthood.

units.source_text: 今所以举行者，实有用意：欲使暂入大学寮，研习学问二三年耳。

en.t: The reason I have done so now is that I have a purpose: I want him to enter the Academy for a time and devote two or three years to study.

units.source_text: 在此期间，只当他没有成人。

en.t: During that period, we may simply regard him as not yet truly grown.

units.source_text: 将来学业成就，便有才能为朝廷效劳而自成一员人物了。

en.t: When his studies are complete, he will have the ability to serve the court and become a person of standing in his own right.

units.source_text: 窃思自身年幼之时，生长九重宫殿之中，不知世事深浅。

en.t: When I think privately of my own childhood, I was raised deep within the imperial palace and knew nothing of the ways of the world.

units.source_text: 昼夜侍奉父皇，所读书籍，实甚有限。

en.t: Day and night I attended upon my father the Emperor, and the books I read were in truth very limited.

units.source_text: 虽然幸蒙父皇亲自传授，但因修养浅薄，年幼无知，故无论研习学问，或调琴吹笛，皆缺乏功夫，不及他人之处甚多。

en.t: Although I was fortunate enough to receive instruction from my father himself, my training was shallow and I was young and ignorant, so in scholarship, in playing the koto, and in the flute, I lacked discipline and fell short of others in many ways.

units.source_text: 聪明儿子胜过愚笨父母，世间少有其例。

en.t: There are few examples in the world of a clever son surpassing foolish parents.

units.source_text: 而且世世相传，势必一代不如一代，相去愈远。

en.t: Moreover, as things are passed down from generation to generation, each generation is bound to decline, and the distance grows ever greater.

units.source_text: 只因有此顾虑，故欲使小儿入学。

en.t: It is precisely because I have this concern that I want the boy to enter school.

units.source_text: 大凡高贵之家的子弟，升官晋爵可以随心所欲，荣华盖世，骄奢成习，则往往视研习学问为苦工，而不屑从事。

en.t: In general, sons of noble houses can gain office and rank almost as they please; surrounded by unmatched splendor and accustomed to arrogance and luxury, they often see study as drudgery and disdain to undertake it.

units.source_text: 此等子弟只知耽好游戏，而官爵自会随意晋升。

en.t: Such young men know only how to indulge in amusements, while their offices and ranks rise of their own accord as they wish.

units.source_text: 于是趋炎附势之人，在腹中蔑视讥笑，而在表面则阿谀奉承，以博得其欢心。

en.t: Then those who chase power and favor despise and mock them inwardly, while outwardly they flatter and fawn in order to win their pleasure.

units.source_text: 在这期间，这子弟俨然成了伟大人物，尊荣无比。

en.t: During this time, the young man appears to have become a great person, honored beyond compare.

units.source_text: 然而一旦时移势变，父母死亡，家运衰落，这人就被世人所轻侮而孤苦无依了。

en.t: Yet once times and circumstances change, his parents die, and the family fortunes decline, he is looked down upon by the world and left lonely and without support.

units.source_text: 如此看来，凡人总须以学问为本，再具备大和智慧而见用于世，便是强者。

en.t: Seen in this light, a person must always take learning as the foundation; if he also possesses Yamato wisdom and is of use in the world, then he is truly strong.

units.source_text: 目前看来，这措施似乎耗费时日，教人焦急，但将来学优登仕，身为天下柱石，则为父母者即使身死，亦无后顾之忧。

en.t: For the present, this course may seem time-consuming and may make one impatient, but if in the future he excels in learning, enters service, and becomes a pillar of the realm, then his parents will have no worries for what comes after, even when they die.

units.source_text: 目前虽未能多多提拔，但在家长照拂之下，想不致被人讥笑为穷书生也。”

en.t: Although I cannot advance him greatly for now, under the care of the head of the family, I believe he will not be mocked as a poor scholar.”
